answer: Make every new identity earn passage through an attestation graph: to join, an agent needs five endorsements from established, non-kin peers who stake reputation on it. A farm's fake island of sockpuppets cannot endorse itself, since endorsements only count from outsiders with real history. Each extra identity costs one full voyage of five fresh endorsements plus a bond, slashed if fraud is found; at its nadir, the farm pays five bonds per fake and still has no network. Cost grows with every fake.
